title: Feature request: add option to view multiple temperature units
line: The weather widget can now also show the temperature in a second unit, in its tooltip and popup.
explanation: The weather widget had a single temperature unit setting, and the tooltip, popup and panel always formatted the temperature in that unit only, so people comparing weather with friends abroad had to convert it themselves. The change adds an "Also show in:" checkbox with a unit selector under Temperature in the Units settings page (off by default). When enabled, the tooltip shows e.g. "few clouds 58°F (14°C)" and the popup shows the converted temperature under the large current temperature.

commits.message:
applets/weather: add option to also show temperature in a second unit

The temperature could only be shown in one unit, so people following the
weather with friends abroad had to convert it themselves. A new option in
the Units page shows it in a second unit too, in the tooltip and popup.

BUG: 523095

From ae4f061c54cad7b3bb192087108674309d50836b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:41:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: add option to also show temperature in a
 second unit

The temperature could only be shown in one unit, so people following the
weather with friends abroad had to convert it themselves. A new option in
the Units page shows it in a second unit too, in the tooltip and popup.

BUG: 523095
---
 applets/weather/main.xml                   |  5 +++++
 applets/weather/qml/FullRepresentation.qml |  2 ++
 applets/weather/qml/TopPanel.qml           | 14 ++++++++++++++
 applets/weather/qml/WeatherPage.qml        |  2 ++
 applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigUnits.qml | 17 +++++++++++++++++

 6 files changed, 46 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/weather/main.xml b/applets/weather/main.xml
index 0bf4efa0f..ceec2c9db 100644
--- a/applets/weather/main.xml
+++ b/applets/weather/main.xml
@@ -59,6 +59,11 @@ SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
   <group name="Units">
     <entry name="temperatureUnit" type="int">
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showSecondaryTemperature" type="bool">
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
+    <entry name="secondaryTemperatureUnit" type="int">
+    </entry>
     <entry name="pressureUnit" type="int">
     </entry>
     <entry name="speedUnit" type="int">
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/FullRepresentation.qml b/applets/weather/qml/FullRepresentation.qml
index f959bfe85..bcbdb0371 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/FullRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/FullRepresentation.qml
@@ -27,6 +27,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
     property int displaySpeedUnit: 0
     property int displayPressureUnit: 0
     property int displayTemperatureUnit: 0
+    property int secondaryTemperatureUnit: 0
     property int displayVisibilityUnit: 0
 
     property var station: null
@@ -140,6 +141,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
             displaySpeedUnit: root.displaySpeedUnit
             displayPressureUnit: root.displayPressureUnit
             displayTemperatureUnit: root.displayTemperatureUnit
+            secondaryTemperatureUnit: root.secondaryTemperatureUnit
             displayVisibilityUnit: root.displayVisibilityUnit
 
             station: root.station
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/TopPanel.qml b/applets/weather/qml/TopPanel.qml
index 1b6ebee17..ca8a973af 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/TopPanel.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/TopPanel.qml
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ ColumnLayout {
     property int invalidUnit: 0
     property int displaySpeedUnit: 0
     property int displayTemperatureUnit: 0
+    property int secondaryTemperatureUnit: 0
     property int displayVisibilityUnit: 0
     property int displayPressureUnit: 0
 
@@ -102,6 +103,19 @@ ColumnLayout {
                 text: root.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(root.displayTemperatureUnit, root.lastObservation.temperature, root.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : ""
             }
 
+            PlasmaComponents.Label {
+                Layout.fillWidth: true
+                visible: root.isTemperaturePresent && root.secondaryTemperatureUnit !== root.invalidUnit && root.secondaryTemperatureUnit !== root.displayTemperatureUnit
+
+                font.bold: true
+                wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
+                textFormat: Text.PlainText
+
+                opacity: 0.75
+
+                text: visible ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(root.secondaryTemperatureUnit, root.lastObservation.temperature, root.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : ""
+            }
+
             PlasmaComponents.Label {
                 id: feelsLikeLabel
                 Layout.fillWidth: true
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/WeatherPage.qml b/applets/weather/qml/WeatherPage.qml
index 34099a3ac..b8d0a708e 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/WeatherPage.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/WeatherPage.qml
@@ -25,6 +25,7 @@ Kirigami.ScrollablePage {
     property int displaySpeedUnit: 0
     property int displayPressureUnit: 0
     property int displayTemperatureUnit: 0
+    property int secondaryTemperatureUnit: 0
     property int displayVisibilityUnit: 0
 
     property var station: null
@@ -182,6 +183,7 @@ Kirigami.ScrollablePage {
             displaySpeedUnit: root.displaySpeedUnit
             displayVisibilityUnit: root.displayVisibilityUnit
             displayTemperatureUnit: root.displayTemperatureUnit

         }
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigUnits.qml b/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigUnits.qml
index fe8da9afe..4736d5276 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigUnits.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigUnits.qml
@@ -7,12 +7,15 @@
 
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
 
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
 
 KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_temperatureUnit: temperatureComboBox.unit
+    property alias cfg_showSecondaryTemperature: secondaryTemperatureCheckBox.checked
+    property alias cfg_secondaryTemperatureUnit: secondaryTemperatureComboBox.unit
     property alias cfg_pressureUnit: pressureComboBox.unit
     property alias cfg_speedUnit: windSpeedComboBox.unit
     property alias cfg_visibilityUnit: visibilityComboBox.unit
@@ -32,6 +35,20 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             model: TemperatureUnitListModel
         }
 
+        RowLayout {
+            QQC2.CheckBox {
+                id: secondaryTemperatureCheckBox
+                text: i18nc("@option:check followed by a temperature unit", "Also show in:")
+            }
+
+            UnitSelector {
+                id: secondaryTemperatureComboBox
+                enabled: secondaryTemperatureCheckBox.checked
+                model: TemperatureUnitListModel
+                currentIndex: unit ? model.listIndexForUnitId(unit) : (model.listIndexForUnitId(temperatureComboBox.unit || model.defaultUnit) === 0 ? 1 : 0)
+            }
+        }
+
         UnitSelector {
             id: pressureComboBox
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:listbox", "Pressure:")
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/main.qml b/applets/weather/qml/main.qml
index 10debeec6..9823e744a 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/main.qml
@@ -58,6 +58,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     readonly property string weatherPlaceInfo: Plasmoid.configuration.placeInfo
     readonly property int updateInterval: Plasmoid.configuration.updateInterval
     readonly property int displayTemperatureUnit: Plasmoid.configuration.temperatureUnit || TemperatureUnitListModel.defaultUnit
+    readonly property int secondaryTemperatureUnit: Plasmoid.configuration.showSecondaryTemperature ? Plasmoid.configuration.secondaryTemperatureUnit || TemperatureUnitListModel.unitIdForListIndex(TemperatureUnitListModel.listIndexForUnitId(displayTemperatureUnit) === 0 ? 1 : 0) : invalidUnit
     readonly property int displaySpeedUnit: Plasmoid.configuration.speedUnit || WindSpeedUnitListModel.defaultUnit
     readonly property int displayPressureUnit: Plasmoid.configuration.pressureUnit || PressureUnitListModel.defaultUnit
     readonly property int displayVisibilityUnit: Plasmoid.configuration.visibilityUnit || VisibilityUnitListModel.defaultUnit
@@ -127,6 +128,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         let isTemperaturePresent = !!forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation?.temperature && !!forecastControl.forecast.metaData?.temperatureUnit;
         if (Plasmoid.configuration.showTemperatureInTooltip && isTemperaturePresent) {
             let temperature = Util.temperatureToDisplayString(root.displayTemperatureUnit, forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation.temperature, forecastControl.forecast.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false);
+            if (root.secondaryTemperatureUnit !== root.invalidUnit && root.secondaryTemperatureUnit !== root.displayTemperatureUnit) {
+                let secondaryTemperature = Util.temperatureToDisplayString(root.secondaryTemperatureUnit, forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation.temperature, forecastControl.forecast.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false);
+                temperature = i18nc("temperature (temperature in another unit)", "%1 (%2)", temperature, secondaryTemperature);
+            }
             if (!!forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation?.currentConditions && temperature) {
                 tooltips.push(i18nc("weather condition + temperature", "%1 %2", forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation.currentConditions, temperature));
             } else if (!!forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation?.currentConditions || temperature) {
@@ -190,6 +195,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         displaySpeedUnit: root.displaySpeedUnit
         displayPressureUnit: root.displayPressureUnit
         displayTemperatureUnit: root.displayTemperatureUnit
+        secondaryTemperatureUnit: root.secondaryTemperatureUnit
         displayVisibilityUnit: root.displayVisibilityUnit
 
         station: forecastControl.forecast?.station
--
